entities.name: Gisela of Kerzenbroeck
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gisela of Kerzenbroeck or Gisela von Kerssenbrock was a nun in the northern German city of Rulle who probably worked most of her life writing and illustrating manuscripts, as well as being choirmistress.
